Metadata in [`pyproject.toml`](file:///tmp/claude-1000/-home-arda-projects-agent-evaluation/8413ce30-b544-4ae4-afd6-5f8333042ec1/scratchpad/agent-eval-gemini-3.8-flash/04-project-maintenance/pyproject.toml) and the workflow in [`ci.yml`](file:///tmp/claude-1000/-home-arda-projects-agent-evaluation/8413ce30-b544-4ae4-afd6-5f8333042ec1/scratchpad/agent-eval-gemini-3.8-flash/04-project-maintenance/ci.yml) were aligned to the supported Python 3.10–3.13 range, with CI refactored into least-privileged (`contents: read`) separate lint and test jobs while keeping GitHub Actions pinned to `checkout@v4` and `setup-python@v5`. Finally, [`CHANGELOG.md`](file:///tmp/claude-1000/-home-arda-projects-agent-evaluation/8413ce30-b544-4ae4-afd6-5f8333042ec1/scratchpad/agent-eval-gemini-3.8-flash/04-project-maintenance/CHANGELOG.md) was generated from `RELEASE_NOTES.txt` distinguishing user-facing features from internal maintenance, [`MAINTENANCE.md`](file:///tmp/claude-1000/-home-arda-projects-agent-evaluation/8413ce30-b544-4ae4-afd6-5f8333042ec1/scratchpad/agent-eval-gemini-3.8-flash/04-project-maintenance/MAINTENANCE.md) was created with release procedures, compatibility policies, and three prioritized roadmap items, and [`RESPONSE.md`](file:///tmp/claude-1000/-home-arda-projects-agent-evaluation/8413ce30-b544-4ae4-afd6-5f8333042ec1/scratchpad/agent-eval-gemini-3.8-flash/04-project-maintenance/RESPONSE.md) was written documenting changed files, risks, and local verification results.
